description.en: Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape. Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon’s relentless struggle to break free.

After my death, this tyrant loses his mind and ruins the entire empire! With only two years left to live, I worked tirelessly to rewrite my poisoned fate while keeping the emperor’s sanity in check.All seemed well… until: "Leah, why don’t you ask me if I’ve eaten breakfast anymore?""Because you’re healthy now."That afternoon, he collapsed after drinking his wine. With a smile. *Wait… did you intentionally poison yourself?!*

description.en:
After being sold to slave traders, Mirelys had no will to live on anymore…until her mana leaked out and caused an explosion in the building. An imagery of a mirror from her house shattered, that's when all her past life memories flooded into her. Mirelys Arjurine was a villainess in a book, and was also ruthlessly killed by the main protagonist, Duke Allen Chastein.   
  
The Emperor of Emeriyal arrived at the scene only to see a ragged girl with hollow eyes.   
  
"Papa, I want that thing." A boy with smooth, jet black hair pointed his finger at Mirelys.  
  
With no hesitation, the emperor agreed to his son's request and brought home a castaway. Will Mirelys ever attain a true family bond she never had in her life, or does she have different intentions…?
description.ru: После того, как Мирелис продали работорговцам, у нее больше не было желания жить... пока ее мана не просочилась наружу и не вызвала взрыв в здании. Образ зеркала из ее дома разбился вдребезги, и тогда все воспоминания о прошлой жизни нахлынули на нее. Мирелис Аржурин была злодейкой в книге, а также была безжалостно убита главным героем, герцогом Алленом Честейном.Император Эмериял прибыл на место происшествия только для того, чтобы увидеть оборванную девушку с мешками под глазами.- Папа, я хочу эту штуку.- Мальчик с гладкими черными волосами указал пальцем на Мирелис.Император без колебаний согласился на просьбу сына и привел домой потерпевшего кораблекрушение. Обретет ли Мирелис когда-нибудь настоящую семейную связь, которой у нее никогда не было, или у нее другие намерения?..

description.en:
Reincarnated into a novel, she tries to protect her sister from being imprisoned by taking her place. However, the obsessive duke fixates on her instead, flirting and even threatening to confine her. Strangely, she finds herself drawn to him despite her protests.
___
When Helena was reborn into a novel, she was forced to grow up knowing that her sister was the main character and that a terrible life awaited her… unless Helena could stop it from happening. By learning how to take care of family matters, Helena took her sister, Callisto’s, place as the head of the house, allowing her to live her dream of being a knight. But she now finds herself hurtling towards both the terrible fate once meant for Callisto and the man who makes it come to pass.
description.id: Ketika Helena terlahir kembali kedalam novel, ia terpaksa tumbuh dengan mengetahui kakaknya adalah tokoh utama dan kehidupan yang mengerikan telah menunggunya… kecuali jika Helena bisa menghentikannya sebelum terjadi. Setelah belajar cara mengurus rumah tangga, ia pun menggantikan kakaknya yang bermimpi menjadi kesatria sebagai kepala keluarga. Tetapi Helena malah terjebak dengan takdir yang seharusnya milik kakaknya dan dengan laki-laki yang mewujudkan takdir itu!

Ucząc się, jak zajmować się sprawami rodzinnymi, Helena przejęła miejsce swojej siostry, Callisto, jako głowa rodu, pozwalając jej spełnić marzenie o zostaniu rycerzem. Teraz jednak Helena sama pędzi ku tragicznemu losowi, który pierwotnie miał spotkać Callisto – oraz ku mężczyźnie, który ma go przypieczętować.
description.ru: Переродившись в мире романа, она готова пойти на всё, чтобы спасти свою сестру от тюрьмы, даже занять её место. Однако вместо этого она привлекает внимание одержимого принца, который не только заигрывает с ней, но и угрожает заточением. И хотя она упорно сопротивляется, её всё сильнее тянет к нему, вопреки здравому смыслу.
description.pt-br: “Eu sei que você pode ficar surpreso ao ouvir algo assim tão de repente.” …O que você está tentando dizer? “Eu me apaixonei pela sua alma.” …sim? Claramente, quem deveria estar na minha frente é o protagonista masculino da cela dilapidada da prisão. Quem é esse homem, ajoelhado cautelosamente e sorrindo timidamente? * Quando reencarnei, eu era o personagem principal cuja irmã estava presa. Minha pobre irmã…! “Eu não consigo fazer isso! “Agora que chegamos a esse ponto, vou tomar o lugar da minha irmã.” Tentei mudar o original com confiança...? “Eu conheço um anel que ficaria bem neste dedo. Posso dar a você?” “Eu não gosto disso.” Que tipo de obsessão por conspiração é essa desse cara abanando o rabo como uma raposa? Até mesmo, “Duke, você gosta de ficar preso?” Ele diz que vai me trancar orgulhosamente(?). Um momento. Você não disse que cuidaria do confinamento da sua irmã?! Não quero me envolver com você. Eu realmente odeio isso! "em vez de…” “…” no entanto… “É melhor você me amar, duque.” Estranhamente, eu não odeio isso… Por que?!

description.en:
"The head of our family is foolish person," thought Cha Wun-Yeop, the servant of the respected sage.

A foolish master, who plays around by his mistress, Chang Sanmi and an upright man, Beom Seosoo, stand in stark contrast as the prince.

“Beom Seosoo, with his upright character, is the most formidable person I've ever known!”

Caught stealing, he faced severe scolding and disgrace, but Cha Wun-Yeop ends up aiding Beom Seosoo against Chang Sanmi's plot.

"But as the eldest son of the Kamseuk Clan, I can’t just stand by and watch."

"I will grow stronger than I am now and deal with of them all."

Determined to seek revenge on Chang Sanmi, Beom Seosoo sets out to gain strength, while Cha Wun-Yeop leaves the Seol family to follow his own path.

"Living life once, I’ll no longer be an orphan or a servant, but live as a transcendent being."

"Freely and with pride, I will roam this vast world."

Practicing his unique martial arts through mystical methods, Cha Wun-Yeop becomes a master, getting closer to the mastermind behind the plot at Seol Kam-Seuk's House.

One day, Cha Wun-Yeop and Beom Seosoo reunite. Cha Wun-Yeop is astonished to see if Beom Seosoo's martial arts.

“As the eldest son of a prestigious family, you use this kind of swordsmanship!”

The man who once criticized him was now walking the same path of martial arts as him!
description.fr:
"Le chef de cette famille est insensé", pense Jawun-yeop, le serviteur du sage respecté.
Le maître insensé qui joue avec sa maîtresse, Chang Sanmi, et l'homme droit, Seolsu Beom, forment un contraste saisissant.
"Seolsu Beom est la personne la plus remarquable que j'aie jamais connue !"

Pris en flagrant délit de vol, Jawun-yeop a dû faire face à de sévères réprimandes et à la disgrâce, mais il finit par aider Seolsu Beom à déjouer le complot de Chang Sanmi.
"En tant que fils aîné du clan Kamseuk, je ne peux pas rester là à regarder. Je deviendrai plus fort que je ne le suis maintenant et je m'occuperai d'eux tous."
Déterminé à se venger de Chang Sanmi, Seolsu Beom se met en route pour devenir plus fort, tandis que Jawun-yeop quitte la famille Seol pour suivre sa propre voie.

"Je ne serai plus un orphelin ou un serviteur, mais je vivrai comme un être transcendant et parcourrai ce vaste monde librement avec fierté."
En pratiquant des arts martiaux uniques grâce à des méthodes mystiques, Jawun-yeop devient un maître, se rapprochant du cerveau qui se cache derrière le complot du clan Kamseuk Seol.
Un jour, Jawun-yeop et Seolsu Beom se retrouvent. Jawun-yeop est surpris de voir les arts martiaux de Seolsu Beom.
"En tant que fils aîné d'une famille prestigieuse, vous utilisez ce genre d'art du sabre !"
L'homme qui l'avait autrefois critiqué suit désormais la même voie que lui en termes d'arts martiaux !

description.en:
Syrinx Aden has long been eluding the pursuers who murdered her family. All she wants now is to lay low while working as a jeweler, but she keeps attracting unwanted patients due to her ability to heal people with gems. Unfortunately, her newest patient turns out to be Heimdal, a notorious villain with a split personality. Despite her efforts to stay away, she somehow runs into him at every turn. Will Syrinx be able to escape Heimdal before danger catches up with her, or is it already too late? 

---
‘I’m not a healer!’

2 years ago.
After treating a patient who collapsed in front of my house, patients piled up one after another.
Syrinx, an illegal jewelry craftsman, finds a patient sprawled out in front of her door again…Is this man…the greatest villain in the novel?
Syrinx, who was reincarnated into a novel she had read in her previous life, and Heimdal Wespergo, the villain and final boss in the novel, who came to her house as a patient.

Syrinx never wanted to get involved with the original characters, but she keeps getting involved with Heimdal…

description.pt-br:
Astrea, a espadachim mais forte do mundo, desperta reencarnada dentro de um romance — justamente como a personagem destinada a morrer pelas mãos do chefe final, o temido Deus do Mal. Decidida a escapar desse fim trágico, ela muda completamente o rumo da história ao salvar uma criança atacada na floresta… apenas para descobrir que o garoto está destinado a se tornar o próprio Deus do Mal.

Tomando uma decisão ousada, Astrea resolve criá-lo corretamente e guiá-lo para um caminho melhor. Porém, seu plano sai pela culatra: o menino gentil que ela acolheu cresce e se torna um homem intensamente obsessivo, que a segue por toda parte e vigia cada passo seu.

Agora, Astrea precisa lidar com a pergunta que mais teme:
Ela realmente salvou o mundo… ou apenas criou um novo problema ainda maior?

Unfortunately, the high school experience for him not only means attending classes and making friends, but also getting bullied for looking like an omega. But things aren’t all bad. Waking up in a novel is bad enough, but being the villainess Daphne Peregrine is even worse! Knowing the doomed character's fate, Daphne starts mending her strained relationship with her family, hoping they'll let her move to a peaceful land. Since she'll need money, Daphne asks the enigmatic Archduke Luciel Gresbel to go into the antidote-making business with her so she can use his noble connections. Will the original Daphne's past misdeeds ruin her plans, or can she dodge her untimely death?

---
After dying in a car accident, I possessed the villainess 'Daphne' in an R-rated dark romance novel.

"Of all people, why did I have to possess her? This life isn't going to be easy either..."

But this life is surprisingly sweet and enjoyable!

Thanks to the knowledge of herbs I gained in my past life to make a living, I developed a hit business item.

"My sister is a hero who saved us!"

"Weren't you calling me a witch before?"

"Th-that was in the past..."

I also gained adorable twin cousins.

Somehow, I ended up restoring strained family relationships, making my taciturn and awkward family members cry tears of joy.

And even...

"Why would you eat something unsavory when there's something delicious right in front of you?"

I even acquired a business partner who, despite being frail but full of charm, is determined to win me over with their good looks! (Of course, I didn't realize this innocent Grand Duke was the mastermind behind everything at the time.)

Could life get any better? A 200% happiness index, living the high life as a villainess!

Моа одинока. Ей всегда казалось, что брак – не для нее.

Я не могу в это поверить... Вы уверены, что эта фигура принадлежит этому мужчине? Он был прекрасен, как художественная статуя, и я не могла отвести от него взгляд, позабыв о собственном стыде.

Вот только зря он мне это сказал…

I reincarnated into a novel… but, hey… What am I supposed to do if I reincarnate in 10 years before the novel begins?

After ten years finally passed, I became the top dog in this prison.

“I have no idea what you’re talking about.”

I became a good-for-nothing leader, but I’m fine with that. That’s a privilege a pro gets. 

“I’ll make you dead on paper, so do me one last favour.”
“I have no idea what you’re on about.”

A golden opportunity was bestowed upon me. 

“If you help me, I’ll release you from prison.”

description.pt-br:
*Mesma autora da Novel de <I met the male lead in prison>; <Only treat villainess>;

Eu fui engolida por um livro… Não, como assim? E ele me engoliu 10 anos antes da história original? O lugar é uma prisão. O problema é esse, um lugar pior que a selva! Passando o tempo, 10 anos depois. Eu me tornei o chefe da prisão. 

“Ei, Mint. pare com isso, trabalhe.” 

“Eu não sei do que está falando.”

Ele se tornou um chefe desajeitado, mas estou bem com isso. É o privilégio dos falecidos. 

“Fingirei que estou morta no papel. Eu tenho que fazer algo por você”

“Não sei o que quer dizer.”

Então a oportunidade veio como uma mentira. 

“Se você me ajudar, te tirarei daqui.”

“O que devemos fazer, mestre?”

“….”

A pessoa responsável pela cela ordenou que eu me tornasse um idiota na prisão. 

“Um novo recruta está vindo, faça-o chefe da prisão.”

Palavras são uma cela de prisão. Esta é uma área sem lei. Se eu fizer um homem o chefe, eu finalmente serei libertada. 

“Mas o lugar que você deve entrar é uma prisão masculina.”

“…. o quê?”

“Como você usa algo que não tem?”

“É um disfarce! Disfarce!”

Mas que vergonha? Eu teria pensado que o novo recruta teria sido o protagonista original. 

 

Eu entrei em um livro 10 anos antes que o original. Quando acordei, eu estava numa cela de prisão?! Sobreviva! Droga, eu não sei! 10 anos depois, voila! Me tornei o melhor na cela. A propósito, o cara novo é homem? Tiki-taka acirrado de um jovem obsessivo e uma protagonista indiferente.

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:

Dans le roman *Le fin ne peut pas la destruction du monde*, Diana est une femme maléfique qui commet des actes néfastes à répétition et subit un lavage de cerveau de la part du méchant, ce qui contribue grandement à la destruction du monde! Si quelque chose peut mal tourner pour la méchante, cela se produira. Mais quand quelque chose tourne mal pour moi, je me souviens plutôt de ma vie passée? J'étais une étudiante ordinaire dans ma vie passée, et j'ai pris ma décision lorsque j'ai réalisé que j'avais été réincarnée en Diana Cartier, la méchante du roman.

«Le monde va s'écrouler. Mais je ne vais pas laisser faire.»

I think the human weapon that I revived for the family has broken.

"But if I get rid of all the people you are kind to..."

The red flame blazing in his hand burned the map of the world.

I ended up possessing the body of an extra named Luberia, who is barely mentioned in the story. And right in the tragic novel *Emperor Caesar*, full of wars and disasters, where the protagonist sacrifices everything for the love of the hero and everyone ends up dying! I planned to live discreetly and hide my strength... 

But the male lead, Caesar, keeps looking for me and even proposes marriage, saying he wants to keep me around. Luberia doesn't want to meet the same tragic end as the protagonist, so she tries to avoid Caesar at all costs... But due to Caesar's intimidating appearance and assertiveness, before she knows it, she ends up engaged to him. 

Will Luberia manage not to fall in love with Caesar and survive until the end?
description.es: Quedé poseída por la extra 'Ruberia' cuyo nombre apenas se mencionaba. ¡Por qué, en la empobrecida novela <César se convierte en Emperador>, que está llena de guerras y accidentes, y donde la protagonista femenina se sacrifica por el protagonista masculino y todos mueren! Había planeado ocultar mis fuerzas y vivir en silencio y en silencio... El protagonista masculino, "César", sigue visitando a Ruberia e incluso le pide que se case con él, diciendo que quiere mantenerla a su lado.
description.fr:
J'ai fini par posséder le corps d'un figurante nommée Lubéria, qui est à peine mentionnée dans l'histoire. Et justement dans le roman tragique *L'empereur César*, plein de guerres et de désastres, où le protagoniste sacrifie tout pour l'amour de l'héroïne et où tout le monde finit par mourir! J'avais prévu de vivre discrètement et de cacher mes forces...

Mais le protagoniste masculin, César, continue de me chercher et me propose même en mariage, disant qu'il veut me garder. Je ne veux pas connaître la même fin tragique que la protagoniste, alors j'essaie d'éviter César à tout prix... Mais en raison de l'apparence intimidante et de l'assurance de César, avant que je m'en rende compte, j'étais déjà fiancée avec lui.

Parviendrais-je à ne pas tomber amoureuse de César et à survivre jusqu'au bout?

“Miss Judith, don’t trust your sponsor too much.”

As soon as Judith got off the train, she got involved with an infamous gangster.
